text:
dara: heads-up from onboarding smoke: model returned a stringified JSON for `payload` and go-sdk's json-mode helper auto-parsed it, which then matched the array branch in our union schema. js-sdk preserved the literal string. resulted in a parity bug and sample-app behaved differently depending on SDK used.

kevin: ugh can you paste the schema + raw response?

dara: simplified schema:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "payload": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "array", "items": {"type":"string"} },
        { "type": "string" }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
raw model response (JSON-mode fncall): `{"payload":"[\"a\",\"b\"]"}` (note payload is a string containing a JSON array).

mona: go-sdk normalizer attempted to be "helpful" and did `if isStringLooksLikeJson(value) parse(value)`, returned `["a","b"]` which then matched array branch. js-sdk kept `"[\"a\",\"b\"]"` and matched string branch. sample-app handlers expecting string path crashed when they got an array.

ryan: oh right, we added that auto-parse heuristic ages ago to deal with noisy tool outputs. But in strict JSON-mode we shouldn't mutate literal types.

kevin: agree. plan: disable auto-parse heuristics in strictJsonMode. Add a telemetry counter `auto_parse_string_json` so we can measure how often models emit stringified JSON and decide if we need a controlled opt-in in older SDKs.

dara: also add a unit test for union[array,string] where model returns a quoted-json-array. Expectation under strictJsonMode: preserve literal string; under legacyCompat mode: parse and coerce.

mona: I'll open PR in go-sdk and add a migration note. PR: https://git.redwood/s/sdk-go/strict-no-autoparse-stringjson (WIP). CI queued.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR strict-no-autoparse-stringjson  build 14620.

ryan: small follow-up: ensure auth/retry flow doesn't accidentally trigger auto-parse on partial bodies. previously we saw truncated responses like `"[\"a` that our parser tried to parse and errored. sanitizer should only attempt parse on complete successful response body. Add integration test that simulates 401 then retry returning full quoted-json-array.

kevin: good call. add test to sample-app runner and a guard in client: only run sanitization after final response with 2xx.

mona: added tests + changelog entry. Also added telemetry and a migration guide entry explaining strictJsonMode default.

dara: CI green, merged, go-sdk v0.6.4 released. will coordinate rolling update for onboarding templates and note the behavior change in quickstart.

ryan: file DEVEX-3722 to track parity checks across sdks (js/py/dotnet/rust/ios) so all SDKs behave consistently by default.

kevin: thanks all. this should cut down on confusing starter app differences. :thumbsup:
